name: Johnson v. United States Congress
summary: Whether a constitutional challenge to a veterans-benefits statute must begin in the veterans courts. Friction is on the page.

name: Mullin v. Doe
summary: Whether courts can review the end of Temporary Protected Status for Haiti and Syria, including a claim that the Secretary skipped the steps the statute requires.

name: Trump v. Barbara
summary: Whether a child born in the United States to parents unlawfully or temporarily present is a citizen at birth under the Citizenship Clause.
